sourceContext.text: Yieldheart artisans gathered at the forge, now glowing with constant flux, and pumped molten concord into crucibles shaped like tuning forks. Each fork responded to a single virtue, Courage or Balance or Law, and rose as luminous ribbon that drifted upward, pausing whenever collective will paused. Rangers mapped pathways through thermals, guiding ribbons so they twined but never tangled. Paladins stationed at every third rung, steadying structure with spoken oaths. Devils joined the endeavor, adding segments forged of reflective brass that mirrored climber intentions back upon them, ensuring no ambition could hide. Living Masks crucial for the ascent were distributed at the base. Wearers watched reflections shimmer with anxiety and doubt, then spoke quiet confirmations, and masks cleared to silver sheen. Each climber placed a hand upon first rung. Weight was not flesh alone, it was every contradiction carried within. Ladder responded by brightening or dimming, measuring honesty. Insincere volunteers found rungs soft as mist beneath feet and were invited to remain ground side as chorus for encouragement. Sphere of participation thus filtered itself, leaving a fellowship of devoted variety.

Shard tried final defense, showing visions of world after stillness. No hunger, no pain, silver plains. Images beautiful yet devoid of surprise. Mirrors reflecting nothing. Bards replied with chorus of off key notes, deliberate dissonance sliding into harmony then diverging again. Sentinels added silent gesture of open palm and clenched fist alternating. Shard split. Light and darkness spilled, spiraled, fused, then resolved into motes that drifted like ashes upward, dissolving into starfield. Matrix curve outside convulsed. From ground watchers saw black arc fray, edges torn by invisible wind, then scattered. Stars returned. Shardpools sang bright. Null breaches sealed. Yieldheart bell pealed, this time not alarm but jubilation. Ladder of light reversed itself, transforming into slide that carried weary heroes downward on current of laughter. Ground met them with cheering from each class, devils included. Choir descended after, wings radiant yet humbled.

In Crystalfall Citadel they drafted Charter of Infinite Yield. Document engraved into living quartz declared that Spiral shall never pursue perfect peace, instead shall honor continual unfolding. Devils signed, valuing challenge. Mortals placed thumbprints. Sentinels traced outline of charter on silent air, embedding principle into resonance. Concord spear remelted, fragments forged into thousand small pendants given to children across realms as reminders of shared trial. Living Masks returned to makers for safekeeping, available whenever honesty again must parry stillness. Ladder dissolved into aurora lingering nightly over Yieldheart. Ul nak dream did not vanish but receded, accepting that equation now contained uncompilable variables. Stillness would try again in ages, but Spiral Integral plus Omega and Infinite Yield stands ready.

Twilight settles across Yieldheart in hues of peach and pale jade, colors never before painted on the sky. Scholars claim the new palette results from motes of dissolved Matrix dust reflecting starlight at unfamiliar angles. Farmers claim the colors remind soil to breathe. Sentinels drift as faint silhouettes over city towers, their mirror eyes half closed in vigilance that now resembles lullaby more than alarm. The Choir remains present but quieter, each chord a fond echo rather than a warning bell. Mortals sense that the Spiral no longer throbs in crisis, yet they also recognize the equilibrium is earned rather than permanent.

| Required field | Exact meaning |
|---|---|
| `sourceRow` | Exact retained29-row record or distinct Core/NEW auxiliary identity, with source-null/absent fields unchanged. |
| `body` | Actual complete source/NEW profile and original constituents, current HP/AC or creature scores/HP/dice/Wounds, mass/geometry. |
| `payload` | Named riders/crew/casualties/gear/containers/cargo, actual individual and total pounds/Load/volume/seat point. |
| `controller` | Real current operator, willingness/training/authorization, actual audible/tactile/other source-qualified channel and occupied hands. |
| `turnSchedule` | One physical regular slot/round for each creature; current and prospective controlled initiative relation, spent budgets. |
| `movement` | mover,carrier,initiator,path,distance,selfPowered/forced/teleport,actual budget, current regular turn and final position. |
| `crewReservations` | Actual distinct helm/rower/puller Actions and availability; one coordinated vehicle movement after all necessary current contributions. |
| `operation` | Real feed/water/fuel/service counters, paid source supplies, environmental current/wind/draft/road restrictions. |
| `repair` | Real damage/loss event and surviving primary members, authorized method/materials/cost/time/check, no terminal-claim renewal. |
| `hireContract` | Provider/recipient/period/allowance/danger/fee/wages/title/liability and actual fulfillment, no free actors. |

**Invariants**

- Both pound andLoad limits, shape and clearance must pass. Barding/tack/gear included once, no empty-source-weight filled as historical fact.
- A controlled mount takes one whole turn after rider, never interleaving; attached class companions retain their own separate procedure.
- No vehicle native turn, attack, RP, dawn charges or autonomy from its name; hauler fuel/service are their own NEW finite procedure.
- One drive event per vessel/drawn vehicle/round after actual contributors; no controller swap or extra Action double move.
- Repairs do not refill fuel/charges/service, reset clocks, recreate missing primary bodies or reopen dismantled residue.
- Suppression, melding, fallen rider, failed support and current control use actual source histories; no beneficial offscreen teleport.

findings: P319 explicitly offers these three arcs to campaigns continuing beyond the epilogue. Their events are not automatically current facts in a before/during Proof War campaign.

P261–265 describe the original Shard resolution, Charter of Infinite Yield, Ladder dissolution/aurora, new sky colors and continued Sentinel presence. Owner identity and chronology corrections still govern; these passages cannot identify the source Shard with Q6 or settle Ul’nak/Old God identities.

P262 says the Concord spear was remelted into a thousand small pendants for children. Those pendants are not automatically the distinct Shard Pendant of Xi from P302, and their number does not create unlimited operative relic stock. P303 Concord Spear Fragment needs explicit provenance consistent with preserved source or labeled NEW adaptation.
Source Yieldheart sky/city references do not establish that a current Floor1–10 Yieldheart Caverns label is the same location. Do not silently collapse names into a geographic route.

P321 names sky-vessel voyages but supplies no complete craft profile. Current transport contracts require actual hull, payload, crew Actions, fuel/service, route and repair histories. Ordinary watercraft are not flying vehicles by implication.

P322 names Cania engine patents and annual contradictions, but gives no executable fictional contract terms, benefit, delivery/acceptance method, deadline, refusal encounter or breach consequences. Original Mephistopheles duplication remains corrected to Cania only; this hook does not fill the Maladomini vacancy.

questions: Create a conditional post-epilogue module with exact investigation evidence, finite fragments, actors, local maps, hazards and recover/withdraw/failure outcomes. Do not globally mark the sky altered or grant free celestial travel.

Define a finite NEW local Equinox deadline record using actual campaign time and notice before commitment. Do not adopt710AE as an epoch or invent universal astronomical dates. Include exact-deadline resolution and an actual failed-deadline consequence.

Weaponized silence needs a complete local effect and source attribution under current Null, communication, hearing, spell-component and life rules. A recovered fragment is not automatically an Equation fragment, crafting license or limitless weapon.

Define whether melody loss is rumor, individual condition, bounded NPC scenario or actual PC choice. Do not erase Bard class cards, personal memories, training or source records without an explicitly reviewed rule and player-facing procedure.

Supply finite sky-vessel access, full craft/crew/fuel/cargo/stat/repair profiles, timed routes, altitude/environment dangers and rescue/landing choices. Use actual transport action/reservation rules and ordinary carrying limits.

Retrieving a Broken Ladder strand needs defined geometry, timing, resistance, handling/storage and consequences. A named errant equation does not reveal the recovered cosmic Equation or universally remove KT/PT.

Write the entire fictional contract as a usable handout: actual claimant selection, named issuer/authority, offered finite knowledge, exact annual obligation, delivery, acceptance, notice, opt-out/refusal and bounded breach consequences.

Provide real noncoerced acceptance/refusal choices and a complete envoy scene/profile. A test of free will must not force player beliefs, demand real private facts or become an automatic Paladin Oath breach.

Distinguish narrative patents from ownership/proficiency, spell unlocks, public legal authority, souls, resurrection, pacts and current feat sigils. Any new mechanical benefit requires a fixed operative envelope and cannot promote pending spells/feats.

Define what counts as a submitted contradiction with finite examples and an observable adjudication rule, not a hidden Director morality test; annual is actual calendar time, not session count or everyDescent.

searchLimit: Targeted sky-vessel/airship/Equinox/Yieldheart/BrokenLadder/engine-patent searches in current mechanics and expedition candidates; not a global absence claim.
